international.title: Erin Patterson launches high court appeal bid over mushroom murder convictions
international.summary: Patterson, 52, seeks leave to appeal to Australia’s highest court over deaths of estranged family members after fatal beef wellington lunch Erin Patterson has applied to the high court seeking leave to appeal after a failed bid last month to overturn her triple murder conviction. Patterson, 52, was found guilty last year of the murders of her estranged husband’s parents, Don and Gail Patterson, and his aunt Heather Wilkinson, after she hosted them for lunch.
